data.exact_reserve_text: The EL/PL book was profitable in 2018 benefitting from reserve releases from prior years. US Casualty business has faced difficult market conditions for some years, however, technical rates on our portfolio remain favourable. We have seen positive rate movement in segments of this class over the past year offering some opportunity for growth. This book has performed well and it has again been possible to release reserves from prior years. Reserves established in 2017 in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria have proved to be adequate with development of reported losses in line with expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced mixed prior year development in 2018. The EL/PL and US Casualty lines of business benefited from reserve releases from prior years. Additionally, reserves established in 2017 for Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria proved adequate, developing in line with expectations. However, due to a reinsurance to close (RITC) arrangement of Syndicate 2255 into Syndicate 435 on 1 January 2018, the claims development triangle is distorted and cannot be reliably used to calculate an overall gross prior year development figure.
